verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a developer platform that ships an SDK, an agent toolkit and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents telemetry collection, usage tracking, or any control to disable them in the agent toolkit, MCP server, or commerce services. The merchant-control language in Store Sync covers brand appearance and customer communications, not telemetry, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
